digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center reconciler live validation
propositions: Bidirectional reconciliation must be proven live against a Dockerized DC instance, using a complete copy of this project's real ticket store with all production Jira bindings and snapshots scrubbed before any mutation is tested.

The working repo in CI must have zero git remotes and must explicitly fetch the orphan tickets branch into .tickets-tracker/ since that path is gitignored, with isolation verified by assertion that git remote returns nothing, not by checking config defaults.

A reconciler pass over a scrubbed copied store must plan exactly zero deletion mutations and zero outbound update mutations before any DC seeding, as failure detection against unbound tickets from which all bindings were removed.

Each of 14 inbound and 14 outbound mutations must round-trip individually through their own cell with a named oracle read directly from the instance, never relying on aggregate convergence signals that became indistinguishable from success on empty input.

Pagination must be proven against a real page-size constraint discovered from the instance, not assumed, with at least 2*observed+1 issues seeded to force three pages and full recovery verified against the fetched plan, not against created-ticket counts.

Three product gaps in Data Center remain unfixed and platform-documented: sub-task reparenting is accepted and no-op'd, clearing a sub-task parent is refused with HTTP 400, and inbound parent changes are not mirrored due to one-way-only implementation.
